evidence.quote: Whistleblower Protection Act of 1989 , Pub. L. 101 - 12 as amended
Whistleblower Protection Act of 1989 , Pub. L. 101 - 12 as amended , is a United States federal law
that protects federal whistleblowers who work for the government and report agency misconduct
A federal agency violates the Whistleblower Protection Act if agency authorities take ( or threaten to take ) retaliatory personnel action against any employee or applicant

A federal agency violates the Whistleblower Protection Act if agency authorities take ( or threaten to take ) retaliatory personnel action against any employee or applicant because of disclosure of information by that employee or applicant
Whistleblowers may file complaints that they believe reasonably evidences a violation of a law , rule or regulation
